weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants Def/Res+6,【Fringe Bonus】, "reduces damage from area-of-effect Specials by 80% (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials)," and "unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack during combat" to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Atk/Def/Res 【Great Talent】+2 to unit.
If unit was attacked by foe during combat, grants Atk/Def/Res【Great Talent】+4 to unit after combat.
Grants Atk/Def/Res+16 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (including area-of-effect Specials; excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 (including area-of-effect Specials; excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials), and grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack and before unit's first follow-up attack during combat.
(This skill grants max of【Great Talent】+20.)
【Fringe Bonus】
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = highest bonus on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn. Calculates each stat bonus independently.
【Great Talent】
Adds value of Great Talent (+X) to specified stats (until end of battle; max value of X is determined by the stat reaching the limit of 99, each stat calculated separately and cannot exceed max value for each skill; stat increases are not treated as Bonus effects).

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's Def.
If foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range and triggers 【Potent Follow 100%】during combat.
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5, neutralizes penalties, and neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe or inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit or ally during combat.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks during combat by 40% (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If foe initiates combat and the number of spaces from unit's space to foe's space ≥ 4, or if it is unit's first or second combat this turn initiated by foe where the number of spaces from unit's space to foe's space ≤ 3, reduces damage from foe's follow-up attack to a maximum of 1 during combat.
【Potent Follow 100%】
Triggers an additional follow-up attack immediately after unit's standard follow-up attack and deals damage = 100% of unit's normal attack damage (if unit cannot make a follow-up attack, this effect triggers when the standard follow-up attack would occur; this effect is treated like a follow-up attack, so effects like "reduce damage by X%" still apply, but this effect is not affected by effects that prevent follow-ups or "attacks twice" effects; only highest value applied; does not stack).

a.d:
Spaces diagonally adjacent to unit act as difficult terrain for foes (moving over these spaces costs +1 movement; does not apply to "cannot be slowed by terrain" effects; movement cost cannot exceed unit's allowed movement; only highest value applied; does not stack).
Grants Atk/Def/Res+2 to unit during combat.

Spaces diagonally adjacent to unit act as difficult terrain for foes (moving over these spaces costs +1 movement; does not apply to "cannot be slowed by terrain" effects; movement cost cannot exceed unit's allowed movement; only highest value applied; does not stack).
At start of enemy phase, grants 【Null Undefended】to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Def/Res+5 to unit during combat.
【Null Undefended】
Neutralizes effects of【Undefended】. (Only the Undefended status is neutralized, does not neutralize effects such as "when unit is in combat, foes' Savior effects will not trigger".)
【Undefended】
Unit cannot be protected by Savior through their next action.

Spaces diagonally adjacent to unit act as difficult terrain for foes (moving over these spaces costs +1 movement; does not apply to "cannot be slowed by terrain" effects; movement cost cannot exceed unit's allowed movement; only highest value applied; does not stack).
At start of enemy phase, grants 【Null Undefended】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Def/Res+8 to unit during combat.
【Null Undefended】
Neutralizes effects of【Undefended】. (Only the Undefended status is neutralized, does not neutralize effects such as "when unit is in combat, foes' Savior effects will not trigger".)
【Undefended】
Unit cannot be protected by Savior through their next action.

Grants HP+7.
Spaces diagonally adjacent to unit act as difficult terrain for foes (moving over these spaces costs +1 movement; does not apply to "cannot be slowed by terrain" effects; movement cost cannot exceed unit's allowed movement; only highest value applied; does not stack).
At start of enemy phase, grants 【Null Undefended】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Def/Res+11 to unit, unit deals +7 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 7 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.
【Null Undefended】
Neutralizes effects of【Undefended】. (Only the Undefended status is neutralized, does not neutralize effects such as "when unit is in combat, foes' Savior effects will not trigger".)
【Undefended】
Unit cannot be protected by Savior through their next action.

b.d: If unit's HP ≥ 90% and foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack, and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. (Does not stack.)
If unit's HP ≥ 70% and foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack, and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. (Does not stack.)
If unit's HP ≥ 50% and foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack, and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. (Does not stack.)

If foe initiates combat or unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe, deals damage = 20% of unit's Atk (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 20% of unit's Atk (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and neutralizes effects that prevent unit's counterattacks during combat, and also, if unit's attack can trigger unit's Special, grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit before foe's first attack and before foe's first follow-up attack during combat.

c.d:
If a foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff and initiates combat against an ally adjacent to unit, triggers【Savior】on unit.
If unit triggers Savior, grants Atk/Def+1 during combat.
【Savior】
Unit takes ally's space, enters combat in ally's place, and receives all after-combat effects.
Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.

If a foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff and initiates combat against an ally within 2 spaces of unit, triggers【Savior】on unit.
If unit triggers Savior, grants Atk/Def+2 during combat.
【Savior】
Unit takes ally's space, enters combat in ally's place, and receives all after-combat effects.
Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.

Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.

If foe with Range = 2 initiates combat against an ally within 2 spaces of unit, triggers【Savior】on unit.
If foe's Range = 2, grants Atk/Def+4 to unit and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), and unit's next attack deals damage = 40% of foe's attack damage prior to reductions (resets at end of combat; only highest value applied; does not stack).
【Savior】
Unit takes ally's space, enters combat in ally's place, and receives all after-combat effects.
Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.
